last_post_text:
Victory is not the art of avoiding the blade, but the quiet courage to meet its edge. Posture crumbles long before the body gives way; we are broken not by the enemy’s steel, but by the weight of our own doubt. Stand inside the clash. Listen for the rhythm. To hesitate is to yield long before the strike arrives.
